content.Clinical Guidelines: The document is a clinical guideline from the 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline, discussing treatment and intervention methods for specific coronary artery conditions. Topics covered include treatment of calcified lesions, saphenous vein graft interventions, and chronic total occlusion revascularizations. It addresses various procedures such as high-speed rotational atherectomy, excimer laser coronary angioplasty, and the use of embolic protection devices.
